question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.customer_id,
        co.pizza_id,
        co.exclusions,
        co.extras,
        co.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name
    FROM pizza_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
),
std_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.pizza_id,
        b.exclusions,
        b.extras,
        b.order_time,
        b.pizza_name,
        TRIM(REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_TABLE(pr.toppings, ',')) as topping_id,
        'standard' as source
    FROM base b
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON b.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
exclusions AS (
    SELECT 
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.pizza_id,
        b.exclusions,
        b.extras,
        b.order_time,
        b.pizza_name,
        TRIM(REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_TABLE(b.exclusions, ',')) as topping_id,
        'excluded' as source
    FROM base b
    WHERE b.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND b.exclusions != ''
),
extras AS (
    SELECT 
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.pizza_id,
        b.exclusions,
        b.extras,
        b.order_time,
        b.pizza_name,
        TRIM(REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_TABLE(b.extras, ',')) as topping_id,
        'extra' as source
    FROM base b
    WHERE b.extras IS NOT NULL AND b.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT * FROM std_toppings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM exclusions
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM extras
)
SELECT 
    order_id,
    topping_id,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM all_toppings
WHERE order_id = 9
GROUP BY order_id, topping_id
ORDER BY topping_id

    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM exclusions
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM extras
)
SELECT 
    order_id,
    topping_id,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM all_toppings
WHERE order_id = 9
GROUP BY order_id, topping_id
ORDER BY topping_id
